prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original fictional PIPE-BOMB LAUNCHER source sprite atlas for Sean in humorous SNES-style plumbing action game. Exaggerated chunky orange industrial tube launcher with heavy dark steel rings, broad cartoon barrel, big dark rear grip and forward support grip. Entirely fictional stylized exterior, no technical construction detail. Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows, equal cells, square transparent canvas. Row1 col1 diagonal inventory icon; col2 held ready launcher horizontal muzzle RIGHT; col3 recoil launcher tilted slightly up-right with short orange puff. Row2 col1 recovered horizontal launcher same grip anchor; col2 isolated chunky capped gray cartoon pipe projectile with orange band angled 35 degrees up-right; col3 same projectile rotated further to convey tumbling. Projectile has simple closed casing, no internal detail. Row3 col1 small white-yellow explosion onset star; col2 large round orange-yellow splashy cartoon blast; col3 dissipating dark-gray smoke puffs and orange embers. All nine full sprites inside generous transparent cell margins, no clipping, consistent launcher design and scale, same grip anchor across held poses. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, navy outlines, limited orange steel yellow palette. No characters, hands, text, labels, grid, backdrop, haze or floor. Genuine transparent alpha.

integration_notes: Source sheet is visually reviewed, not a validated runtime atlas.
Generated sprites can cross nominal cell edges; inspect and isolate regions before import.
Measure per-frame grip pivots and muzzle sockets; preserve one weapon scale across held poses.
Do not fit every frame to its opaque bounds; that changes tool scale and grip alignment.
Existing character sheets include baked-in weapons. Clean hand/body layers are needed before attaching these tools.
Mirror held sprites for left-facing play; effects should use their contact or muzzle origin.
Visual effects do not define collision, damage, reach, travel distance, or blast radius.
Clean alpha fringes and validate readable icons and effects at gameplay size.
Fire pose includes muzzle effect; prevent duplicate effect/projectile rendering at release.
